cli.usage_head:
orbit-mem — shared AI memory, retrospective storage and activity log for this PC

Commands:
flag.activity.project: all for every project; a project directory; default this project
flag.activity.since: only activity since YYYY-MM-DD, an RFC 3339 time, or 7d / 12h ago
flag.audit.days: days of automatic changes to show
flag.backup.yes: restore without asking (the change is printed first)
flag.edit.link: id of a memory to link (repeatable)
flag.edit.title: new title
flag.edit.unlink: id of a linked memory to unlink (repeatable)
flag.export.out: file (jsonl) or folder (md); without it jsonl goes to stdout
flag.hook.launcher: with --runtime: who asked orbit-pi for the session (studio, telegram, workflow…); default ORBIT_LAUNCHER or orbit-pi
flag.hook.record_only: prompt hook only: record the activity alone, inject no memories and record no injection (a run whose instruction already carries its step recall)
flag.hook.runtime: orbit-pi only: the runtime that started this session calls the hook itself (ORBIT_RUNTIME=orbit-pi turns the plugin hooks off)
flag.import.dry_run: only check what would be imported
flag.inject.cwd: working directory that picks the project scope
flag.inject.host: host name recorded with the use event
flag.inject.session: session id, to keep the session bundle stable
flag.install.apply_target: file or directory retrospectives may propose changes to (repeatable)
flag.install.dry_run: only show what would be done
flag.install.local_plugin: register Claude Code from the local plugin folder this orbit-mem builds, not the GitHub marketplace
flag.install.no_hosts: do not build or register the plugin in Claude Code and Codex
flag.install.no_schedule: do not touch the OS schedule (not even an earlier orbit-mem retrospective schedule)
flag.install.plugin_source: OpenOrbit plugin source directory (empty: the source OpenOrbit's harness carries; remembered once given)
flag.mcp.actor: who writes through this server: ai (default), user (a person's app such as Orbit Studio), automation. Inside a retrospective run it is always automation
flag.mcp.reader: for apps such as Orbit Studio: opens only memory_graph (read only)
flag.mcp.retro: retrospective id (opens only the tools of that retrospective run)
flag.memory.state: state candidate|confirmed|stale|hidden (repeatable; default candidate and confirmed)
flag.migrate.from: copy of the old Knowledge SQLite
flag.plugin.out: folder for both host formats and both local marketplaces (default: $ORBIT_HOME/plugins/orbit-mem)
flag.plugin.repo: repository root to write the GitHub marketplace into (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json and plugin/, Claude Code format)
flag.proposals.body_file: file with the body to approve with
flag.proposals.title: title to approve with
flag.stats.days: number of days up to today
usage.activity: orbit-mem activity [query] [--host H] [--project all|DIR] [--since DATE] [-n N] [--json]   # session activity log and old work.db sessions (activity_find)
usage.audit: orbit-mem audit [--days N] [--json] | audit revert <ledger-or-proposal-id> [--note] | audit dismiss <f-…|correction:…> | audit harness [--json]   # audit list: automatic confirmations and clean-ups, conflicts, repeated corrections
usage.backup: orbit-mem backup [list|status|restore <copy> [--yes]]   # copy the memory DB now · list copies · their state · restore one
usage.edit: orbit-mem edit <id> [--title T] [--body B | --body-file F] [--tag T]... [--link ID]... [--unlink ID]... [--note N] [--json]   # fix a memory (memory_update)
usage.export: orbit-mem export [--format jsonl|md] [--out PATH] [--all]   # jsonl to stdout, or Markdown files in a folder
usage.hook: orbit-mem hook session-start|prompt|session-end --host claude|codex [--runtime orbit-pi --launcher L]   # host hooks (stdin JSON): memory context and the activity log
usage.import: orbit-mem import <file.jsonl> [--dry-run] [--json]   # add exported memories; ids already there are skipped
usage.inject: orbit-mem inject session-start|prompt [--cwd DIR] [--session ID] [--host orbit-pi|orbit-code] [--rules brief|full]   # memory context for orbit-pi and Orbit Code as JSON (prompt on stdin); inject delivered --host H --session S --ids A,B records what a host sent to the model
usage.install: orbit-mem install [--bin-dir D] [--local-plugin] [--no-hosts] [--retro-host claude|codex] [--retro-model M] [--plugin-source DIR] [--apply-target PATH]... [--no-schedule] [--dry-run]
usage.ledger: orbit-mem ledger [--all] [--n N] [--json]   # approved changes and their effect verdicts
usage.list: orbit-mem list [--kind K]... [--state S]... [--tag T]... [--all] [-n N] [--json]   # recent memories
usage.mcp: orbit-mem mcp [--retro ID | --reader]   # MCP server the hosts start (stdio): memory tools and activity_find. --reader is the read-only memory graph
usage.plugin: orbit-mem plugin build [--out D | --repo R]   # orbit-mem's own Claude Code and Codex plugin
usage.proposals: orbit-mem proposals [list|review|show <id>|approve <id> [--title T] [--body B|--body-file F] [--note N]|reject <id> [--note N]] [--all]
usage.retro-store: orbit-mem retro-store prepare|finish|queue list|queue add|queue mark|state|list|sessions|backup|judge|settle|work-metrics|work-signals|experiment …   # the storage API OpenOrbit uses (orb retro, the harness lab dev tool), JSON results
usage.search: orbit-mem search <query> [--kind K]... [--all] [--stale] [-n N] [--json]   # find memories (memory_find)
usage.stale: orbit-mem stale <id> [--note N] [--json]   # mark a memory stale (kept, not deleted)
usage.stats: orbit-mem stats [--days N | --week YYYY-MM-DD (a Monday)] [--json]   # corrections, recall, use verdicts, ledger, proposals and retrospective metrics
usage.uninstall: orbit-mem uninstall   # removes the plugin from the hosts and an earlier orbit-mem retrospective schedule; keeps the memory DB
flag.inject.rules: form of the confirmed rules: brief (one line each) or full; brief for --host orbit-code
flag.inject.ids: delivered: memory ids the host put into the model request, comma separated
